authorization.scope: one new full-Train REAL bigram gamma fit and Test inference; no Kaggle upload

input.record_id: identity and row alignment only; never a model feature

required_components: A02 C2_B structured state, scaler, OHE, and C2_B LogisticRegression
C1_B structured state and HGB missing-stream fallback
frozen A02 E79 Test probabilities and routed POS_BAG_OFFSET probabilities

features.tokenizer: the exact saved full-Train A02 C2_B TfidfVectorizer preprocessor and tokenizer
features.pair_sequence: all adjacent normalized token pairs; OOV pairs remain in the sequence and define positions
features.position_bins: floor(3*j/n_pair), with zero-based pair occurrence j
features.feature: exact frozen bigram-vocabulary phrase, original IDF, (1+log(count))*IDF, one whole-row L2 normalization
features.new_fit_arm: REAL only; no E79 BAG or SHUFFLED estimator fit

model.fixed_offset: C2_B bag intercept + C2_B bag matrix @ saved coefficients + original full-Train unigram-position matrix @ saved gamma
model.new_parameters: one REAL bigram-position gamma vector, initialized to zero; no new intercept
model.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize, L-BFGS-B, jac=True, maxiter=2000, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-6, maxls=50
model.acceptance: optimizer success, finite gamma/loss/gradient, final objective <= zero-gamma objective + 1e-8

inference_policy.missing_stream: exact saved full-Train C1_B HGB probability

budget.cap_amendment: one new slot, append-only, no released-slot reuse

boundaries.fit_labels: read only after the unique durable FIT_STARTED ledger event; full official Train only
boundaries.test: feature inference only after the trained-state freeze is committed

output.status: exploratory candidate for Sol review; not submitted
